subject.title: 飞书话题群(Topic Group)被识别为p2p导致消息路由错误

question: Which Feishu discriminator should OpenClaw treat as authoritative when an `oc_...` conversation arrives with `chat_type: "p2p"`?
rationale: Source inspection reproduces the misroute, but current tests also protect direct-message thread behavior for `p2p` events with thread metadata, so the permanent classifier needs maintainer intent rather than an automated guess.

options.title: Verify Narrow Topic-Group Evidence
options.body: Treat only maintainer-verified Feishu topic-group evidence as group, then update inbound routing, mention-forward detection, and regression tests for both topic groups and true direct threads.

options.title: Adopt Broader Topic-Anchor Work
options.body: Use the broader topic-anchor PR direction if maintainers want that model to own the classifier and reply-anchor behavior together.

options.title: Keep Strict Chat-Type Semantics
options.body: Leave `p2p` direct unless Feishu reports `topic_group`, accepting that this report stays open until stronger live vendor evidence identifies a safe discriminator.

recommendation.title: Verify Narrow Topic-Group Evidence
recommendation.body: Treat only maintainer-verified Feishu topic-group evidence as group, then update inbound routing, mention-forward detection, and regression tests for both topic groups and true direct threads.

likelyOwner.reason: The current checkout points this person at the central classifier/helper lines and broader Feishu-area history is shared across several topic-routing contributors.
